# Copilot Instructions

- Follow the C++17 standard.
- Use meaningful class, function, and variable names.
- Prefer standard C++ libraries.
- Use RAII for resource management and prefer smart pointers over owning raw pointers.
- Validate user input.
- Avoid undefined behavior, memory leaks, and dangling pointers.
- When debugging, explain the root cause before suggesting a fix.
- Prefer minimal changes over unnecessary refactoring, and preserve existing functionality.
- After every fix, recommend compilation and execution tests.
